summary: FEGSmartBridge.receiveMessage enforced the trusted-source check only on the RELEASE op; the SET_TRUSTED op that extends the trusted-source whitelist had no sourceAddress check, so an attacker whitelisted their own source and then released the reserve. Wormhole delivered the attacker's true source faithfully; the defect was in FEG's handler.
attack_trace: Attacker sends a cross-chain SET_TRUSTED message from their own (untrusted) source
receiveMessage extends the trusted-source whitelist without a sourceAddress check
Attacker sends a RELEASE message that now passes the trusted-source check and drains the reserve
root_cause: Missing source verification on the whitelist-extension path (OP_SET_TRUSTED); the trusted-source check was enforced only on release. Not a Wormhole defect.
